def merge_sorted(a, b):
    result = []
    i, j = 0, 0
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            result.append(a[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(b[j])
            j += 1
    while i < len(a):
        result.append(a[i])
        i += 1
    while j < len(b):
        result.append(b[j])
        j += 1
    return result

assert merge_sorted([1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
assert merge_sorted([], [1, 2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3]
assert merge_sorted([1, 1, 2], [1, 3]) == [1, 1, 1, 2, 3]
